+      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1'
+      SUPABASE_INTERNAL_IMAGE_REGISTRY: ghcr.io

+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

+        with:
+          node-version: 22
+          cache: npm
+      - run: npm ci
+      - name: Keep disposable ports separate
+        run: |
+          reserved=$(cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_reserved_ports)

+          set -euo pipefail

+          mkdir -p "$cli_dir"
+          curl -fsSL -o "$cli_dir/cli.tar.gz" https://github.com/supabase/cli/releases/download/v2.40.7/supabase_linux_amd64.tar.gz
+          echo "21dccbcecb9d2ffff4e48ed953539fe223b23becf13e0213a30c2d9a4054d258  $cli_dir/cli.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
+          tar -xzf "$cli_dir/cli.tar.gz" -C "$cli_dir" supabase
+          echo "568db201105cf8c261226fc16ab412ecc3b7bd03f25ea657852127a638b1601c  $cli_dir/supabase" | sha256sum -c -
+          test "$("$cli_dir/supabase" --version)" = '2.40.7'
+          echo "$cli_dir" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+      - name: Registry read access for test images only
+        run: echo "$GHCR_TOKEN" | docker login ghcr.io --username "$GHCR_USER" --password-stdin
+        env:
+          GHCR_USER: ${{ github.actor }}
+          GHCR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+      - name: Start real isolated Supabase
+        run: npm run test:backend
+      - name: Protected applied history and active release verification
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          git diff --exit-code 8e49fcb684211318a76d1cf0e3ade35acdc036e4 -- supabase/migrations supabase/proposals supabase/release supabase/verify supabase/release-plan.json
+          set -a; . ./.env.test.local; set +a
+          case "$TEST_DATABASE_URL" in postgresql://*@127.0.0.1:*) ;; *) echo 'Not an isolated database'; exit 1 ;; esac
+          # All active release checks must pass on these exact reviewed files. No baseline verifier override.
+          for phase in '145_company_setup|company_setup_145' '146_tolra_provided_ai|tolra_provided_ai_146' '147_job_delivery_note|job_delivery_note_147' '148_job_profitability_actuals|job_profitability_actuals_148' '149_xero_launch_hold|xero_launch_hold_149' '150_ai_cap_key_off|ai_cap_key_off_150'; do
+            IFS='|' read -r release verify <<< "$phase"
+            psql "$TEST_DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -X --single-transaction -f "supabase/release/$release.release.sql"
+            psql "$TEST_DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -X -At -F '|' -f "supabase/verify/$verify.sql" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/builder3-verify.rows"
+            awk -F'|' 'BEGIN { n=0; bad=0 } { n++; if ($NF != "t") bad++ } END { exit(n == 0 || bad != 0) }' "$RUNNER_TEMP/builder3-verify.rows"
+          done
+          psql "$TEST_DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -X -c "NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';"
+      - name: Build against only the disposable backend
+        run: |
+          set -a; . ./.env.test.local; set +a
+          NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL="$TEST_SUPABASE_URL" NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="$TEST_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY" npm run build
+      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+      - name: Block new connections outside disposable services during browser proof
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          for firewall in iptables ip6tables; do
+            sudo "$firewall" -N BUILDER3_BROWSER_EGRESS
+            sudo "$firewall" -A BUILDER3_BROWSER_EGRESS -o lo -j RETURN
+            sudo "$firewall" -A BUILDER3_BROWSER_EGRESS -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j RETURN
+          done
+          # Published loopback ports can be DNATed onto this job's Supabase bridge.
+          networks=$(docker inspect supabase_db_tolra-local-test --format '{{range $name, $config := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{$name}} {{end}}')
+          test -n "$networks"
+          for network in $networks; do
+            while read -r subnet; do
+              test -n "$subnet" || continue
+              case "$subnet" in *:*) firewall=ip6tables ;; *) firewall=iptables ;; esac
+              sudo "$firewall" -A BUILDER3_BROWSER_EGRESS -d "$subnet" -j RETURN
+            done < <(docker network inspect "$network" --format '{{range .IPAM.Config}}{{println .Subnet}}{{end}}')
+          done
+          for firewall in iptables ip6tables; do
+            sudo "$firewall" -A BUILDER3_BROWSER_EGRESS -j REJECT
+            sudo "$firewall" -I OUTPUT 1 -j BUILDER3_BROWSER_EGRESS
+          done
+          # Reserved documentation address, never a provider. Kernel rejection must prevent a connection.
+          python3 - <<'PYBLOCK'
+          import socket
+          try:
+              socket.create_connection(("198.51.100.1", 443), timeout=2)
+          except OSError:
+              print("New external connections blocked for browser/backend proof")
+          else:
+              raise SystemExit("External egress unexpectedly available")
+          PYBLOCK
+      - name: Execute all eight actual browser cases
+        run: |
+          mkdir -p evidence
+          npx playwright test tests/e2e/integrations-connect.spec.ts --reporter=list,json
+        env:
+          E2E_SKIP_BUILD: '1'
+          PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_NAME: evidence/invite-browser.json
+      - name: Fail unless all eight actually passed
+        if: always()
+        run: node scripts/ci-evidence.mjs playwright evidence/invite-browser.json 8
+      - name: Record and remove only this job's test egress rules
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          mkdir -p evidence
+          for firewall in iptables ip6tables; do
+            sudo "$firewall" -L BUILDER3_BROWSER_EGRESS -v -n >> evidence/invite-browser-egress.txt 2>&1 || true
+            sudo "$firewall" -D OUTPUT -j BUILDER3_BROWSER_EGRESS 2>/dev/null || true
+            sudo "$firewall" -F BUILDER3_BROWSER_EGRESS 2>/dev/null || true
+            sudo "$firewall" -X BUILDER3_BROWSER_EGRESS 2>/dev/null || true
+          done
+      - name: Record exact subject and source-profile limits
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          mkdir -p evidence
+          git rev-parse HEAD > evidence/invite-browser-sha.txt
+          printf '%s\n' 'Browser-only diagnostic. Stronger financial/151 contracts remain separate red DB gates; this does not approve a release.' > evidence/invite-browser-scope.txt
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: builder3-invite-browser-${{ github.run_id }}
+          path: |
+            evidence/invite-browser*
+            test-results/
+            evidence/run8-microsoft*
+            !test-results/e2e-state/world.json
+          retention-days: 7
+      - name: Stop only this job's disposable Supabase
+        if: always()
+        run: npm run test:backend:stop

+type MicrosoftDiagnostic = { kind: string; [key:string]: unknown };
+const microsoftDiagnostics: MicrosoftDiagnostic[] = [];
+const diagnosticUrl = (value:string) => { try { const u=new URL(value);return {origin:u.origin,path:u.pathname,hasState:u.searchParams.has("state"),challengeLength:u.searchParams.get("code_challenge")?.length??0}; }catch{return {invalid:true};} };

+});
+
 test("5. the company admin's Microsoft Connect is enabled and goes to Microsoft's sign-in with the fixed redirect URI, a state and a code challenge", async ({ page, baseURL }) => {
   const origin = originOf(baseURL);
+  // Observe the original failure before changing its waits, transport, MFA or navigation behavior.
+  page.on("request",r=>{if(r.url().includes("/api/integrations/microsoft/connect")||r.url().startsWith("https://login.microsoftonline.com/"))microsoftDiagnostics.push({kind:"request",method:r.method(),url:diagnosticUrl(r.url())});});
+  page.on("response",async r=>{if(!r.url().includes("/api/integrations/microsoft/connect"))return;const b=await r.json().catch(()=>({}));microsoftDiagnostics.push({kind:"connect-response",status:r.status(),code:b.code??null,error:b.error??null,authorize:b.url?diagnosticUrl(b.url):null});});
+  page.on("requestfailed",r=>{if(r.url().includes("/integrations/")||r.url().startsWith("https://login.microsoftonline.com/"))microsoftDiagnostics.push({kind:"request-failed",url:diagnosticUrl(r.url()),error:r.failure()?.errorText});});
+  page.on("framenavigated",f=>{if(f===page.mainFrame())microsoftDiagnostics.push({kind:"navigation",url:diagnosticUrl(f.url())});});

   const app = microsoftApp();

@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+# Run8 Microsoft Connect diagnosis, not a fix
+
+Exact observed source: `8e49fcb684211318a76d1cf0e3ade35acdc036e4`. Run https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/actions/runs/42172753204 , integration job127744195322. Main browser605 passed,1 failed,3 did not run; failure is `page.waitForRequest`90s at tests/e2e/integrations-connect.spec.ts:298. Serial tests6/7/8 did not execute. A timeout alone does not classify navigation/listener/app/network failure.
+
+Read-only artifact13484354018 contains only db.json, rehearsal.json, reviewer.json, safeupdate-sessions.log and e2e-state/{identity.json,blocked-network.log}. NO trace.zip, screenshot or error-context.md was uploaded. The server's blocked-network log is empty; it does not observe browser egress. Main trace filenames appear in the log but are absent from the artifact. Reviewer config shares default test-results output and is run after the main suite before the only upload. This explains the lost failure trace, not the Microsoft failure itself.
+
+DIAGNOSIS PENDING: cannot honestly choose(a),(b) or(c) from the surviving evidence. New own-branch workflow preserves the exact source app and database, original Microsoft wait/click/assertions, adds only redacted browser request/response/navigation observations and retains trace before any second runner. No app repair, timeout extension, MFA bypass, listener replacement or weakened assertion. All8cases still required; missing backend/skips fail. Synthetic Supabase only, IPv4/IPv6 new external connections refused before browsers, no credentials/providers/deploy. Existing mocks remain. Run7 uses legacy token invites on this exact source; do not replace it with151 tests without also changing the application under review.
+
+Code/PM review required before any fix. Draft branch `codex/run8-microsoft-diagnosis`, frozen own base `codex/run8-base-8e49fcb`. No candidate/main/#415 edits. Next: inspect this fresh trace, classify, write smallest regression/fix, prove all8including6/7/8 and report exact SHA. This targeted diagnostic does not replace full CI or candidate review.
